message: is the entire thickness of the epithelium characterize by a predominantly lymphocytic infiltrate?
reply:
Based on the image provided, yes, the entire thickness of the tissue section shown is characterized by a dense, predominantly lymphocytic infiltrate.

The small, dark, round cells distributed throughout the larger, pinker epithelial cells are characteristic of lymphocytes. These infiltrating cells are visible from the surface down through the full depth of the tissue shown in the slide.
